title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend Services
description:
Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
**This position is based out of India (Hyderabad).**

**Who We Need**

* Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse engineering team to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend services engineering experience and a proven track record of building reliable, scalable, cloud-native systems.
* This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can design and deliver backend APIs, distributed services, data-driven applications, and platform capabilities using Microsoft Azure and .NET technologies. You will work closely with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to build services that power Truveta’s healthcare data platform.
* As a senior engineer, you will also help shape technical direction, drive engineering best practices, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the long-term reliability, scalability, and maintainability of Truveta’s services.

**This Opportunity**

  
  
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  

* Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same cutting-edge technological innovations that have transformed other industries. We are looking for passionate senior software engineers who are excited to apply their backend engineering expertise to help revolutionize healthcare.
* In this role, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and operate cloud-native backend services that support Truveta’s platform. You will build APIs, service integrations, data processing capabilities, and scalable application components using Azure, .NET, and modern engineering practices.
* This opportunity requires strong software engineering fundamentals, technical leadership, creative problem solving, and the ability to build high-quality services that are secure, observable, reliable, and maintainable at scale.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the design, development, testing, and maintenance of backend services using C#, .NET, and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Design and build RESTful APIs, service integrations, background workers, and data processing components.
* Develop and operate services that run on Microsoft Azure.
* Partner with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to define and deliver reliable platform capabilities.
* Make sound technical decisions that balance scalability, performance, security, reliability, and delivery speed.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and set a high bar for engineering quality.
* Participate in and lead design reviews, code reviews, debugging, and production issue resolution.
* Build secure services that follow engineering best practices for authentication, authorization, data protection, and compliance.
* Improve observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Drive service reliability, performance improvements, and operational readiness.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and help improve team practices.
* Learn and apply domain knowledge related to healthcare data, distributed systems, and large-scale cloud platforms.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience developing backend services, APIs, or cloud-based applications.
* Strong hands-on programming experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Proven experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, or distributed backend systems.
* Experience building and operating cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure.
* Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices including unit testing, code reviews, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and production service ownership.
* Solid understanding of security concepts such as authentication, authorization, secrets management, secure API design, and data protection.
* Experience troubleshooting complex issues across services, infrastructure, data stores, and distributed systems.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, influence design decisions, and mentor other engineers.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to deliver high-quality software in a fast-moving engineering environment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Azure services.
* Experience building scalable services using ASP.NET Core, Web API, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, queues, messaging, or data pipelines.
* Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployment.
* Experience with observability tools and practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health monitoring.
* Experience improving service reliability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Experience working with healthcare, data platforms, analytics platforms, or regulated environments.
* Interest in building reliable software that improves healthcare outcomes and helps save lives with data.

It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

**What you'll do**

* Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
* Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
* Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
* Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
* Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
* Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
* Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
* A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
* Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
* Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
* A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

**Nice to have**

* Contributions to open-source inference engines or GPU kernels (CUDA, HIP, Triton).
* Experience with AMD ROCm or non-GPU AI accelerators.
* Experience with KV-cache systems (e.g. LMCache, Mooncake), speculative decoding or disaggregated serving.
* Experience with model quantization and accuracy evaluation.

In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
* Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
* Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
* Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
* Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

* Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
* Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
* Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
* Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment

* Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)

* CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
* Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
* Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Data Science Intern (Python, Pandas, Statistics, Data Visualization)
description:
Job Title: Data Science Intern (Python, Pandas, Statistics, Data Visualization)

Company: SkillzenLoop

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time internship

Duration: 1 to 3 months

Stipend: INR 10,000 to 12,000 per month

The short version

Data does not make decisions by itself. Someone has to explore it, test ideas against it and explain what it really says. In this internship at SkillzenLoop you will be that person. You will work through messy datasets, apply statistics to real questions and present findings that a non-technical reader can act on.

What your first weeks look like

- Week 1: set up Python and Jupyter, load a real dataset and clean it with Pandas and NumPy

- Week 2: explore the data to find patterns, outliers and relationships, and chart them with Matplotlib or Seaborn

- Week 3: run statistical tests such as correlation and hypothesis testing, and build a simple predictive model

- Week 4: check how well the model performs, write up your findings in plain language and present them to the team

- Every day: document your notebook so others can repeat your work and share progress in a short check-in

Skills you should already have

- Working knowledge of Python, especially Pandas and NumPy

- Understanding of basic statistics (mean, variance, distributions, probability)

- Familiarity with Matplotlib, Seaborn or a similar visualisation library

- Comfort with open-ended problems and checking whether an idea holds up

- A laptop and a stable internet connection

Skills that will help but are not required

- Basic SQL

- Exposure to Scikit-learn

- A Kaggle notebook, GitHub project or certificate

Open to

- Final-year students and recent graduates from B.Tech, B.E., BCA, B.Sc (Statistics, Maths, CS, IT), MCA, M.Sc, MBA (Analytics) or related streams

- Self-taught learners who can show a project or certificate

- Freshers, with no prior experience needed

- Candidates who can work full-time for the internship period

What you take away

- Work on real datasets and business questions

- Regular feedback from experienced team members

- Notebooks and case studies you can show in interviews

- Internship completion certificate

- The freedom to work from your own city anywhere in India

Work schedule

Full-time, Monday to Saturday or as assigned by your reporting manager, with a short daily check-in and a weekly review.

How to apply

Apply on this listing with your updated resume. In the application form, select "Data Science" under Job Position.

SkillzenLoop is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, background and community.
